csharpDecision: EmitReferencePlace recursively resolves field/index places. EmitReferenceElementPointer allocates fresh NextTemp names for each bounds predicate, trap label pair and element address.
slgDifference: emitMutableReferenceIndexPlace recursively emits field-backed index steps, but all array/data/length/index/bounds locals and labels use only call identity and argument ordinal. _place already carries projection depth; the other temporaries do not.
decision: Include the existing indexedBaseProjectionDepth in every index-step temporary/label, preserving _place depth/address chaining, bounds checks, argument/root semantics and stable call identity.
